data.title: Ethereum ETFs lead crypto fund inflows as Bitco... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum spot ETFs attracted $103.9 million in net inflows last week, continuing strong institutional demand despite market volatility. In contrast, Bitcoin ETFs saw a sharp decline in weekly inflows to $33.79 million after heavy outflows midweek, with trading volume hitting its lowest since April 2025. Altcoin ETFs like XRP, Solana, and Chainlink also saw notable inflows, while Hyperliquid ETFs continued to experience outflows and declining assets. This trend highlights growing investor preference for Ethereum amid Bitcoin's slowing momentum, with market watchers keen to see if Ethereum maintains its lead or Bitcoin rebounds.
